explication: Omnigraph is an object-storage-native graph database for typed, versioned data and unified retrieval. A user works through the CLI or server; cluster configuration declares graphs, schemas, stored queries, and policies, then deployment applies them before queries and mutations run. The README also highlights branch-and-merge workflows, multimodal retrieval, security, and blob data. Several internal links below reflect documented capabilities; unsampled implementation details are not treated as verified call paths.
